lines.text: Photos: an X-E5 RAW now opens in true colour, learnt from the camera's own JPEG, at the camera's brightness.
Photos shows a RAW and its JPEG as one photo, marked RAW+JPEG; the editor opens the RAW.
Give a photo stars or a heart: hold it on the shelf, or swipe up on it in the editor.
In the editor, swipe left or right to go through your photos while you pick the best.
